SELECT 
    sciregistry,
    scieqref,
    measurementaccuracypercent,
    calibrationstatus,
    ROUND(CAST(
        measurementaccuracypercent * CASE 
            WHEN calibrationstatus = 'Valid' THEN 1.0
            WHEN calibrationstatus = 'Due' THEN 0.7
